steps.name: Treasure Hunt (1)
steps.objective: First talk to [Io] in 「Gerda」, then defeat [Argos] in 「Icicle Prison」 to obtain <Mint Chocolate Icicle Shaved Ice>. Then turn in the quest to [Atkina] in 「Burning Wheel」.

lines.text: (Io sits blankly on a bench in a quiet part of Gerda Village.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: What is the matter, Io?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I have nothing to do...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: You've been busy since morning. You cleaned your house and the village, did the laundry, played with the children, exercised, and had a meal.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: It's only been three hours, and you say there's nothing to do? Just rest without thinking for a while.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'm bored...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I suppose it's because I no longer have to do all the things I used to.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I'm bored...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: You're not like that older girl who does nothing and complains of boredom, but I'm still surprised to hear you say it.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I know. I've worked for centuries without a moment to be bored. Even this feeling is unfamiliar now.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: A visitor arrives just in time.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Oh, is that %s? %s! %s! Over here!

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: We have been waiting for you, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You were waiting for me?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io keeps singing about how bored she is. What am I to do?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't believe Io is bored. She's not Lady Shynic...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Indeed. We have been together for centuries, and I have never seen her like this.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: ...Shall we go visit Lord Atkina?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: All the way to Dragon Valley?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: No. He's inside the Burning Wheel now. It's near the snowfield, so you can come too, Narin.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Very well. Let us go together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If he's in the wheel, he must be in his true form.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Yes. Lord Atkina seems to have used a lot of energy. He's hungry, so I want to bring something to tempt his appetite.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That sounds good. To the Snowflower Inn?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: No, to Icicle Prison. I made a separate freezer there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's food in there?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io, surely you do not mean 'that'?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Yes. A dish inspired by the latest trend in Freios. Galette helped me make it.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Shall we go, then?
(Narin stares speechlessly at the food Io and %s are holding.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io, how did you become so fond of this?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Even a spirit like me can tell that people will either love it or hate it. What do you think, %s?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: This 'Mint Chocolate Icicle Shaved Ice'...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm... I'd eat it if it were there, but I wouldn't go looking for it.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: ...Is it that bad?
(Utterly puzzled, Io looks back and forth between the shaved ice and Narin.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Lord Atkina might surprise us and like it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-who knows? Well, shall we go?

steps.name: Treasure Hunt (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Echo] in 「Echo Spring」 to obtain an <Ancient Pluton Dragon's Blue Scale>. Then turn in the quest to [Atkina] in 「Burning Wheel」.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Hmm. I'm hungry.
(The dragon Atkina quietly rubs his belly with a hand—or rather, a forepaw.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Strange. I feel empty whenever I'm inside the wheel. Ah, Io?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Lord Atkina, here you are.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The empty wheel worried me, so I returned. Oh, you've come too. It's only been a few days, but I'm pleased to see you again.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hello, Lord Atkina. I'm glad to see you too.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Ah, and you are... a spirit. No, a spirit king.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: I have only seen you from afar, so my greeting is overdue, Lord Atkina. I am Narin.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I've heard you are the Spirit King of Water and Ice. Thank you for watching over Io. Please continue to look after her.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io has her peculiarities. I can only thank you for being so considerate of her.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Listen to her talk. Lord Atkina, you seemed very hungry, so I brought you a special treat.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: A special treat? I look forward to it.
(Atkina falls silent for a moment at the sight of Io's Mint Chocolate Icicle Shaved Ice.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Io, I appreciate the effort... Yes, I mustn't disregard your kindness. I'll have a bite...
(Atkina throws back his head and roars into the empty space inside the wheel.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Lord Atkina...?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I almost said something dreadful. Io, next time, bring me meat, like you did for Valdrick...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io, Lord Atkina seems rather upset.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...I've never seen him react so strongly.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Please don't be too angry.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I'm sorry. You went to all this trouble, and this old fool complained about the food. I didn't expect to remain in this form for so long.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I understand. I've been feeling strange lately too. With all my old duties gone, I'm bored.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Io, do you mean bored to death, like Shynic?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I don't know. I feel like an empty icebox. As though I might melt away at any moment...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Io, may I fill that emptiness for you?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: As if I don't know what you're thinking. You'll hold me down and make me drink loads of water. Do you enjoy drowning your friend that much?
(Narin chuckles at Io's reaction, then notices something near Atkina's waist.)

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Oh, Lord Atkina. Some of your scales are missing. Are you well? You are not ill, are you...?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: A few must have come loose while I used my power inside the wheel. They seem to have flown toward Echo Spring.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Perfect timing. Io, would you find them for me? Think of it as a treasure hunt...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: A treasure hunt...
(Io pauses in thought, then takes %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: We'll be back, Lord Atkina. Come with me, %s. I feel we'll find them quickly with you there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Just like that? Huh?
(At that moment, the dragon Atkina's voice flows into %s's mind.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: 「...Go with her, for Io's sake.」
(Atkina gives a quiet, meaningful nod.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then... shall we go together, Io?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you, %s.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: While you visit Echo Spring, Narin can keep me company.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Would my company be agreeable to you?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Of course. Any conversation is a pleasure between those about to become friends.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Then please look after our Narin, Lord Atkina. Now, to the spring for treasure!
(As Io takes %s's hand and leaves the wheel, Atkina turns toward Narin.)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Ah, Narin. Lady Gaia left a message for you.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: What? The goddess herself? What did she say?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: She said she was glad you were there to freeze Deborah, part of a continent nearly consumed by fire, and save so many lives... And...
(While searching Echo Spring, Io and %s spot something sparkling blue among the ice and snow.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Found them!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Those are definitely Lord Atkina's scales. I thought we'd be searching for ages. I'm glad it was quick.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Lord Atkina sent me here on purpose.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: When was it? Long ago. Very long ago, though not quite beyond memory...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I used to play in the snowfield with my parents. Nothing grand. They would hide little things like these for me to find.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Like a treasure hunt. Sometimes I stayed out quite late looking. But my parents never scolded me...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: 'Ionis, you're a child who keeps searching until you find anything. If you face difficulties someday, never give up. Keep going, just as you do now.' That's what they said...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: I suppose someone like Lord Atkina would have known my parents. He must have sent me on this treasure hunt deliberately. Hehe...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: It was fun. I wasn't bored.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you feel?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Wonderful. Hehe. Like I've been out for a pleasant stroll.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm glad.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't really do anything...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Your very presence is a gift to us, %s. Hehe... I'm not the only one who thinks so.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're giving me too much credit.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Hehe. Take it however you like. Perhaps I can afford to live a little more leisurely now?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Of course, I'll still do what needs doing. The world doesn't turn warm just because the ice in front of you melts.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Let's go. Lord Atkina must be waiting.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Shall we?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Oh, you're back?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, we're back!

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: We're back, Lord Atkina! Did you wait long, Narin?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Lord Atkina and I enjoyed a pleasant conversation.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did you talk about?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: The nature of beauty.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Was it about having an eye for the difference between cuteness and beauty? What Veled mentioned...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Similar, but a little different. We spoke of the ancient gods, the spirits, and life in those times.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: It was fascinating, Lord Atkina. I am glad you enjoyed my stories as well.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, what stories did you tell?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Stories of your childhood. How adorable you were, so unlike now... There was a boy you liked, wasn't there?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Just wait until we get back to the village. I'll give you plenty of affection. Hehe.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Please do. Hehehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ahaha...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Oh, we found the treasure—I mean, the scales.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I'm glad you found them so quickly. No need to give them back to me.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: I've heard humans say that dragon scales bring good luck and health. They are my gift to you, Io.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Thank you, Lord Atkina! They're beautiful.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: When the opportunity arises, I'll prepare gifts for %s and Narin as well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's no need, Lord Atkina.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Your very presence is a gift, Lord Atkina.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Thank you for saying so. It is all thanks to Lady Gaia's grace...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Without her grace, I might have become an evil being like Gluart.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Like how I might have become someone else without Iris...)

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: At the time, I never cared what story lay behind Gluart. Only later did I learn that he had lured many humans to their deaths with his scales.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: That was my failing... In the end, I had looked away...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Before going to slay him, Ziskad came to question me.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: He wanted to be certain that I, a follower of the goddess, was different from Gluart. Fortunately, we agreed. Otherwise, one of us would no longer be here.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Ziskad and the others who became Champions must have grown uneasy about becoming something other than ordinary humans. They must have spent so long alone...

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Like me... Still, we are fortunate. We can stand together as friends, rather than enemies.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: It is thanks to you that we came to trust in this. You brought us all together.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, no. I hardly did anything.

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Too much modesty will get an icicle through your heart. Accept what you've done.

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Hehe. Many people have changed because of you, %s.

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Yes. You are already a treasure to us all.
(Io and Narin smile brightly at Atkina's words.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're embarrassing me. Ahaha...

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: No need to be embarrassed. Lord Atkina, would you like to spend a little more time with us?

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: Gladly. Shall we continue our conversation?

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Conversation is pleasant, but how about this?
(Narin opens the scroll she is carrying, and all sorts of objects fall from it.)

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Narin, you came prepared.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Cards, dice, even a game board...

lines.speaker: 나린
lines.text: Let us enjoy ourselves together. With these, we can play until the sun sets without even noticing!

lines.speaker: 아드키나
lines.text: May an old fellow who doesn't know the rules join in?

lines.speaker: 이오
lines.text: Of course. These games are more fun when everyone plays together.
(Io raises a flurry of snow to tuck cards into Atkina's forepaw. Narin deals the remaining cards, explains the rules, and the game begins.)
(Before long, the Burning Wheel fills with the laughter of those enjoying the game. Though one person may feel differently.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, I lost again.
